question: What consolidated net income did Alliance Global Group report for the first quarter of 2026?

docs.title: AGI: Material Information/Transactions
docs.text:
AGI REPORTS 1Q NET INCOME OF P7.8B, UP 6%

Alliance Global Group, Inc. (AGI), the holding company of tycoon Dr. Andrew L. Tan, delivered a net income of P7.8 billion, a 6% increase from the normalized profit of P7.4 billion the previous year. This comparison accounts for the deconsolidation of Golden Arches Development Corp (GADC) in March 2025 and excludes one-time gains of P3.4 billion.Consolidated revenues reached P42.2 billion, up 1% from the normalized level of P42.0 billion, driven by growth in residential, leasing, hospitality, and spirits. Net income attributable to owners also rose by 5% to P5.2 billion.

Reclassification of Php3,983.1 (in millions) Appropriated Retained Earnings to Unappropriated Retained Earnings

Please be informed that at its meeting today, 12 May 2026, the Board of Directors of Filinvest Land Inc. (“FLI”) approved the reclassification of Php3,983.1 (in millions) from appropriated retained earnings to unappropriated retained earnings. This reclassification was undertaken in accordance with the guidance issued by the SEC – Office of the General Accountant. The adjustment is non-cash in nature and does not affect FLI’s unrestricted retained earnings, total stockholders’ equity, reported net income, or cash flows. This accounting reclassification aligns the presentation of the transaction with the SEC’s prescribed financial reporting treatment for similar transactions.
